> The relevel function was included to allow candidates to easily follow the best practice, for GLMs, to make the largest category the baseline for a factor variable, as noted below. Candidates only sometimes took the hint, which was included to help candidates deal with some difficulties in this particular GLM.

The second is how to change the order of the levels for a factor (categorical variable). This can make a difference for GLM results as the first level becomes the baseline and all but the first level become additional predictive variables. In general, for GLMs it is good set the base (reference) level to the one that has the most observations.

```{r}
# levels(data.frame$CATEGORICAL)
# data.frame$CATEGORICAL <- relevel(data.frame$CATEGORICAL, ref = "Level Name")
# levels(data.frame$CATEGORICAL)
# the levels function might help you see the effect of the change
# replace "data.frame" with the name of your dataframe (2 times)
# replace "CATEGORICAL" with the name of a variable that is a factor (categorical variable) (2 times)
# replace "Level Name" with the name of the level that should become the first level
```

> The Poisson loglikelihood was included both here and in Beryl's work below because it is highly appropriate for this problem and yet candidates did not need to be spending their time deriving this and figuring out how to make it work with the offset. Most candidates took this up as the validation measure as intended, though some also checked other measures like RMSE.

The third is a function that measures the quality of fit of predicted versus actual outcomes. It is the loglikelihood function for a Poisson model (up to a constant) and can be used to assess fit against the data used to build the model or against a test set. I will mention the Poisson model later on in this file. As with any loglikelihood function, less negative or more positive values indicate a better fit.

There are some special considerations taken care of by this function. At times when using trees, the predicticted value is slightly negative (a computer issue) when it should be zero. In addition, when the predicted value is zero, the log cannot be taken. If the target is zero, evaluating the loglikehood to zero makes sense. If not, a small value such as 0.000001 can be used. These adjustments are made in the function.

>This one needs to be left uncommented and then run so that the function can be used later.

```{r}
LLfunction <- function(targets, predicted_values){
  p_v_zero <- ifelse(predicted_values <= 0, 0, predicted_values)
  p_v_pos <- ifelse(predicted_values <= 0, 0.000001 ,predicted_values)
  return(sum(targets*log(p_v_pos)) - sum(p_v_zero))
}
# "targets" is a vector containing the actual values for the target variable
# "predicted_values" is a vector containing the predicted values for the target variable
```

```{r}
## ---- utils, include=FALSE -----------------------------------------------
# Robust helpers used by both training and prediction

clean_nonfinite <- function(df) {
  for (cn in names(df)) if (is.numeric(df[[cn]])) {
    bad <- !is.finite(df[[cn]])
    if (any(bad)) df[[cn]][bad] <- NA_real_
  }
  df
}

align_to_train <- function(X, train_cols) {
  miss <- setdiff(train_cols, colnames(X))
  if (length(miss)) {
    X <- cbind(X, matrix(0, nrow = nrow(X), ncol = length(miss),
                         dimnames = list(NULL, miss)))
  }
  X[, train_cols, drop = FALSE]  # enforce order, drop extras
}

# Build X and y from the same model.frame so rows never desync
build_xy <- function(df, y_name, for_training, col_ref = NULL) {
  df  <- clean_nonfinite(df)
  fml <- as.formula(sprintf("%s ~ .", y_name))

  mf <- model.frame(fml, data = df, na.action = na.pass, drop.unused.levels = FALSE)
  y  <- model.response(mf)

  if (for_training) {
    keep <- !is.na(y)
    mf   <- mf[keep, , drop = FALSE]
    y    <- y[keep]
  } else {
    if (anyNA(y)) y <- NULL  # treat “data” with NA labels as prediction-only
  }

  X <- model.matrix(delete.response(terms(mf)), data = mf)
  if ("(Intercept)" %in% colnames(X)) {
    X <- X[, setdiff(colnames(X), "(Intercept)"), drop = FALSE]
  }
  if (!is.null(col_ref)) X <- align_to_train(X, col_ref)

  list(X = X, y = y)
}

# Safe prediction helper that ALWAYS returns a vector of length nrow(df_raw)
safe_predict_xgb <- function(df_raw, model, y_name, train_cols, fac_levels) {
  df <- df_raw
  # lock factor levels to training
  for (nm in names(fac_levels)) if (nm %in% names(df)) {
    df[[nm]] <- factor(df[[nm]], levels = fac_levels[[nm]])
  }
  df <- clean_nonfinite(df)

  fml <- as.formula(sprintf("%s ~ .", y_name))
  mf  <- model.frame(fml, data = df, na.action = na.pass, drop.unused.levels = FALSE)
  X   <- model.matrix(delete.response(terms(mf)), data = mf)
  if ("(Intercept)" %in% colnames(X)) {
    X <- X[, setdiff(colnames(X), "(Intercept)"), drop = FALSE]
  }
  X <- align_to_train(X, train_cols)

  d  <- xgb.DMatrix(X, missing = NA)
  p  <- as.numeric(predict(model, d))

  out <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(df_raw))
  idx <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(rownames(X)))  # rows represented in X
  out[idx] <- p
  out
}

```

```{r}
data$home_implied <- data$total_line / 2 + data$spread_line / 2
data$away_implied <- data$total_line / 2 - data$spread_line / 2

data$posteam_implied <- ifelse(data$posteam == data$home_team, data$home_implied, data$away_implied)
data$defteam_implied <- ifelse(data$posteam == data$home_team, data$away_implied, data$home_implied)

data$Score_target <- ifelse(data$posteam == data$home_team, data$home_score, data$away_score)
data$Score_target_cover <- ifelse(data$Score_target  > data$posteam_implied, 1, 0)

data$OppScore_target <- ifelse(data$posteam == data$home_team, data$away_score, data$home_score)
data$OppScore_target_cover <- ifelse(data$OppScore_target  > data$defteam_implied, 1, 0)


data$favored_by <- ifelse(data$posteam == data$home_team, data$spread_line, -data$spread_line)

data$ScoreAllowed_target <- ifelse(data$posteam == data$home_team, data$away_score, data$home_score)
data$ScoreAllowed_target_cover <- ifelse(data$ScoreAllowed_target  > data$defteam_implied, 1, 0)

data$Win_target <- ifelse(data$Score_target > data$ScoreAllowed_target, 1, 0)

data$ScoreDiff_target <- ifelse(data$posteam == data$home_team, data$home_score-data$away_score, data$away_score-data$home_score)
data$ScoreDiff_target_cover <- ifelse(data$ScoreDiff_target  > data$favored_by, 1, 0)

data$ScoreTotal_target <- data$home_score+data$away_score
data$ScoreTotal_target_cover <- ifelse(data$ScoreTotal_target  > data$total_line, 1, 0)


```

#XGBoost for Score Diff

```{r}

## =========================
## XGBoost for DIFF SCORE (ScoreDiff_target)
## Train on ONE row per game (home only),
## with standardized target and better grid,
## then map predictions (with correct sign) back to full train/test/val/data
## =========================

library(dplyr)
library(xgboost)

## -------------------------
## 0) Helpers
## -------------------------
RMSE <- function(a, b) sqrt(mean((a - b)^2, na.rm = TRUE))

clean_nonfinite <- function(df) {
  for (cn in names(df)) if (is.numeric(df[[cn]])) {
    bad <- !is.finite(df[[cn]])
    if (any(bad)) df[[cn]][bad] <- NA_real_
  }
  df
}

align_to_train <- function(X, train_cols) {
  miss <- setdiff(train_cols, colnames(X))
  if (length(miss)) {
    X <- cbind(
      X,
      matrix(
        0,
        nrow = nrow(X),
        ncol = length(miss),
        dimnames = list(NULL, miss)
      )
    )
  }
  X[, train_cols, drop = FALSE]
}

# Build X / y from a single model.frame so rows stay aligned
build_xy <- function(df, y_name, for_training, col_ref = NULL) {
  df  <- clean_nonfinite(df)
  fml <- as.formula(sprintf("%s ~ .", y_name))

  mf <- model.frame(
    fml,
    data = df,
    na.action = na.pass,
    drop.unused.levels = FALSE
  )

  y <- model.response(mf)
  if (for_training) {
    keep <- !is.na(y)
    mf   <- mf[keep, , drop = FALSE]
    y    <- y[keep]
  } else {
    if (anyNA(y)) y <- NULL
  }

  X <- model.matrix(delete.response(terms(mf)), data = mf)
  if ("(Intercept)" %in% colnames(X)) {
    X <- X[, setdiff(colnames(X), "(Intercept)"), drop = FALSE]
  }

  if (!is.null(col_ref)) {
    X <- align_to_train(X, train_cols = col_ref)
  }

  list(X = X, y = y)
}

# Copy home prediction to away rows with NEGATED sign (for margin)
copy_home_to_away <- function(df) {
  needed <- c("game_id", "posteam_type", "ScoreDiff_xgb")
  if (!all(needed %in% names(df))) return(df)

  home_rows <- df$posteam_type == "home"
  away_rows <- df$posteam_type == "away"

  home_gid  <- df$game_id[home_rows]
  home_pred <- df$ScoreDiff_xgb[home_rows]

  # Away margin = - home margin
  df$ScoreDiff_xgb[away_rows] <- -home_pred[match(df$game_id[away_rows], home_gid)]
  df
}

## -------------------------
## 1) Build modeling frames
##    (include IDs + target explicitly)
## -------------------------
# Assumes:
#   - game_id exists
#   - posteam_type is "home"/"away"
#   - ScoreDiff_target exists (home_score - away_score)

train2 <- train_home %>%
  dplyr::select(game_id, posteam_type, 556:557, 957:965, 968:969, 972:973, 976:977, 979:980, 983:984, 988:989, 992:993, 997:999, 1004:1018, 1025:1029, 1031:1033, 1036:1055, 1079:1080, 1084, 1101, ScoreDiff_target)

test2  <- test %>%
  dplyr::select(game_id, posteam_type, 556:557, 957:965, 968:969, 972:973, 976:977, 979:980, 983:984, 988:989, 992:993, 997:999, 1004:1018, 1025:1029, 1031:1033, 1036:1055, 1079:1080, 1084, 1101, ScoreDiff_target)

val2   <- val %>%
  dplyr::select(game_id, posteam_type, 556:557, 957:965, 968:969, 972:973, 976:977, 979:980, 983:984, 988:989, 992:993, 997:999, 1004:1018, 1025:1029, 1031:1033, 1036:1055, 1079:1080, 1084, 1101, ScoreDiff_target)

data2  <- data %>%
  dplyr::select(game_id, posteam_type, 556:557, 957:965, 968:969, 972:973, 976:977, 979:980, 983:984, 988:989, 992:993, 997:999, 1004:1018, 1025:1029, 1031:1033, 1036:1055, 1079:1080, 1084, 1101, ScoreDiff_target)

# home/away indices in the FULL frames (for mapping later)
train_home_idx <- train$posteam_type == "home"
test_home_idx  <- test$posteam_type  == "home"
val_home_idx   <- val$posteam_type   == "home"

## -------------------------
## 2) Training frame: HOME rows only
## -------------------------
train_df <- train2 %>%
  filter(posteam_type == "home")

train_home_gid <- train_df$game_id  # if you want game-level mapping later

# For modeling, drop identifiers
train_df <- train_df %>%
  dplyr::select(-game_id, -posteam_type)

# Test / val / data frames keep ALL rows for prediction
test_df <- test2 %>%
  dplyr::select(-game_id, -posteam_type)

val_df  <- val2 %>%
  dplyr::select(-game_id, -posteam_type)

data_df <- data2 %>%
  dplyr::select(-game_id, -posteam_type)

## -------------------------
## 3) Align factor levels across datasets
## -------------------------
fac_cols_diff <- names(Filter(is.factor, train_df))

for (cn in fac_cols_diff) {
  lv <- levels(train_df[[cn]])
  if (cn %in% names(test_df)) test_df[[cn]] <- factor(test_df[[cn]], levels = lv)
  if (cn %in% names(val_df))  val_df[[cn]]  <- factor(val_df[[cn]],  levels = lv)
  if (cn %in% names(data_df)) data_df[[cn]] <- factor(data_df[[cn]], levels = lv)
}
fac_levels_diff <- lapply(train_df[fac_cols_diff], levels)

## -------------------------
## 4) Build matrices (DIFF target)
## -------------------------
y_name_diff <- "ScoreDiff_target"

# TRAIN defines the feature universe (HOME rows only)
bt  <- build_xy(train_df, y_name_diff, for_training = TRUE)
X_train_diff <- bt$X
y_train_diff <- as.numeric(bt$y)
train_cols_diff <- colnames(X_train_diff)

# TEST / VAL aligned to TRAIN cols (all rows)
#bte <- build_xy(test_df, y_name_diff, for_training = TRUE,
#                col_ref = train_cols_diff)
#X_test_diff <- bte$X
#y_test_diff <- as.numeric(bte$y)
#
#bv  <- build_xy(val_df, y_name_diff, for_training = TRUE,
#                col_ref = train_cols_diff)
#X_val_diff <- bv$X
#y_val_diff <- as.numeric(bv$y)


# TEST: build X for all rows, keep y from the original test df
bte <- build_xy(test_df, y_name_diff, for_training = FALSE,
                col_ref = train_cols_diff)
X_test_diff <- bte$X
y_test_diff <- as.numeric(test_df[[y_name_diff]])

# VAL: same idea
bv  <- build_xy(val_df, y_name_diff, for_training = FALSE,
                col_ref = train_cols_diff)
X_val_diff <- bv$X
y_val_diff <- as.numeric(val_df[[y_name_diff]])



# DATA: treat as unlabeled for prediction
bd <- build_xy(data_df, y_name_diff, for_training = FALSE,
               col_ref = train_cols_diff)
X_data_diff <- bd$X
y_data_diff <- if (!is.null(bd$y)) as.numeric(bd$y) else NULL

## -------------------------
## 5) Standardize target + DMatrix
## -------------------------
stopifnot(
  nrow(X_train_diff) == length(y_train_diff),
  nrow(X_test_diff)  == length(y_test_diff),
  nrow(X_val_diff)   == length(y_val_diff)
)

if (!is.null(y_data_diff) && nrow(X_data_diff) != length(y_data_diff)) {
  message(
    sprintf(
      "DATA guard: rows(X_data_diff)=%s, len(y_data_diff)=%s -> treating as unlabeled.",
      nrow(X_data_diff), length(y_data_diff)
    )
  )
  y_data_diff <- NULL
}

# Standardize target
y_mu_diff <- mean(y_train_diff, na.rm = TRUE)
y_sd_diff <- sd(y_train_diff,  na.rm = TRUE)

y_train_std <- (y_train_diff - y_mu_diff) / y_sd_diff

dtrain_diff <- xgb.DMatrix(X_train_diff, label = y_train_std, missing = NA)
dtest_diff  <- xgb.DMatrix(X_test_diff,  missing = NA)
dval_diff   <- xgb.DMatrix(X_val_diff,   missing = NA)
ddata_diff  <- xgb.DMatrix(X_data_diff,  missing = NA)


## -------------------------
## 6) Hyperparameter tuning via xgb.cv (with early stopping)
##    (slightly looser grid for noisy margin)
## -------------------------
set.seed(215)
## =========================
# Load previously tuned params + nrounds
## =========================
tuned_diff <- readRDS("../output/xgb_Billydiff_best_params.rds")

best_diff_params  <- tuned_diff$params
best_diff_nrounds <- tuned_diff$nrounds

cat("\nReusing DIFF hyperparameters:\n")
str(best_diff_params)
cat("nrounds:", best_diff_nrounds, "\n")

## Train final DIFF model with reused hyperparams
xgb_diff_model <- xgb.train(
  params    = best_diff_params,
  data      = dtrain_diff,
  nrounds   = best_diff_nrounds,
  watchlist = list(train = dtrain_diff),
  verbose   = 0
)


## -------------------------
## 8) Predictions back into train/test/val/data
## -------------------------
# Initialize columns
train$ScoreDiff_xgb <- NA_real_
test$ScoreDiff_xgb  <- NA_real_
val$ScoreDiff_xgb   <- NA_real_
data$ScoreDiff_xgb  <- NA_real_

# TRAIN (home rows used to fit the model)
train_pred_std <- predict(xgb_diff_model, dtrain_diff)
train$ScoreDiff_xgb[train_home_idx] <- y_mu_diff + y_sd_diff * train_pred_std

# TEST / VAL / DATA (all rows, then home→away sign fix)
test_pred_std <- predict(xgb_diff_model, dtest_diff)
val_pred_std  <- predict(xgb_diff_model, dval_diff)
data_pred_std <- predict(xgb_diff_model, ddata_diff)

test$ScoreDiff_xgb <- y_mu_diff + y_sd_diff * test_pred_std
val$ScoreDiff_xgb  <- y_mu_diff + y_sd_diff * val_pred_std
data$ScoreDiff_xgb <- y_mu_diff + y_sd_diff * data_pred_std

# Copy home margin to away with NEGATIVE sign
train <- copy_home_to_away(train)
test  <- copy_home_to_away(test)
val   <- copy_home_to_away(val)
data  <- copy_home_to_away(data)

## -------------------------
## 9) Evaluation (DIFF, home rows only)
## -------------------------
h_train <- train$posteam_type == "home"
h_test  <- test$posteam_type  == "home"
h_val   <- val$posteam_type   == "home"

# Baseline: always predict 0 margin
baseline_rmse <- sqrt(mean(train$ScoreDiff_target[h_train]^2, na.rm = TRUE))
cat("\nBaseline RMSE (always 0, DIFF, home rows): ", baseline_rmse, "\n")

cat("\nTRAIN (DIFF, home rows):\n")
cat("  RMSE:       ", RMSE(train$ScoreDiff_target[h_train],
                          train$ScoreDiff_xgb[h_train]), "\n")
cat("  Correlation:", cor(train$ScoreDiff_target[h_train],
                         train$ScoreDiff_xgb[h_train]), "\n")
if (exists("LLfunction")) {
  cat("  LogLik:     ", LLfunction(train$ScoreDiff_target[h_train],
                                  train$ScoreDiff_xgb[h_train]), "\n")
}

cat("\nTEST (DIFF, home rows):\n")
cat("  RMSE:       ", RMSE(test$ScoreDiff_target[h_test],
                          test$ScoreDiff_xgb[h_test]), "\n")
cat("  Correlation:", cor(test$ScoreDiff_target[h_test],
                         test$ScoreDiff_xgb[h_test]), "\n")
if (exists("LLfunction")) {
  cat("  LogLik:     ", LLfunction(test$ScoreDiff_target[h_test],
                                  test$ScoreDiff_xgb[h_test]), "\n")
}

cat("\nVALIDATION (DIFF, home rows):\n")
cat("  RMSE:       ", RMSE(val$ScoreDiff_target[h_val],
                          val$ScoreDiff_xgb[h_val]), "\n")
cat("  Correlation:", cor(val$ScoreDiff_target[h_val],
                         val$ScoreDiff_xgb[h_val]), "\n")
if (exists("LLfunction")) {
  cat("  LogLik:     ", LLfunction(val$ScoreDiff_target[h_val],
                                  val$ScoreDiff_xgb[h_val]), "\n")
}

## -------------------------
## 10) Cover-vs-line accuracy for DIFF (optional)
## -------------------------
# Optional cover vs spread
if (all(c("favored_by","ScoreDiff_target_cover") %in% names(train))) {
  ok <- !is.na(train$ScoreDiff_xgb) & !is.na(train$favored_by)
  acc <- 1 - mean(ifelse(train$ScoreDiff_xgb[ok] >= train$favored_by[ok], 1, 0) != train$ScoreDiff_target_cover[ok])
  cat("TRAIN Cover Accuracy (ScoreDiff): ", acc, "\n", sep = "")
}
if (all(c("favored_by","ScoreDiff_target_cover") %in% names(test))) {
  ok <- !is.na(test$ScoreDiff_xgb) & !is.na(test$favored_by)
  acc <- 1 - mean(ifelse(test$ScoreDiff_xgb[ok] >= test$favored_by[ok], 1, 0) != test$ScoreDiff_target_cover[ok])
  cat("TEST  Cover Accuracy (ScoreDiff): ", acc, "\n", sep = "")
}
if (all(c("favored_by","ScoreDiff_target_cover") %in% names(val))) {
  ok <- !is.na(val$ScoreDiff_xgb) & !is.na(val$favored_by)
  acc <- 1 - mean(ifelse(val$ScoreDiff_xgb[ok] >= val$favored_by[ok], 1, 0) != val$ScoreDiff_target_cover[ok])
  cat("VAL   Cover Accuracy (ScoreDiff): ", acc, "\n", sep = "")
}

## -------------------------
## 11) Feature importance (peek)
## -------------------------
imp_diff <- xgb.importance(model = xgb_diff_model)
print(head(imp_diff, 20))

## -------------------------
## 12) Safe prediction helper for NEW data
## -------------------------
safe_predict_diff <- function(new_df) {
  df <- new_df

  # ensure we have the same columns as train2 (including target col, which can be NA)
  needed_cols   <- names(train2)
  missing_cols  <- setdiff(needed_cols, names(df))
  if (length(missing_cols)) {
    for (cn in missing_cols) df[[cn]] <- NA_real_
  }
  df <- df[, needed_cols, drop = FALSE]

  # align factor levels
  for (cn in fac_cols_diff) if (cn %in% names(df)) {
    df[[cn]] <- factor(df[[cn]], levels = fac_levels_diff[[cn]])
  }

  # drop identifiers from modeling frame
  df_model <- df %>% dplyr::select(-game_id, -posteam_type)

  bx <- build_xy(df_model, y_name_diff, for_training = FALSE,
                 col_ref = train_cols_diff)
  X_new <- bx$X

  dnew <- xgb.DMatrix(X_new, missing = NA)
  pred_std <- as.numeric(predict(xgb_diff_model, dnew))
  y_mu_diff + y_sd_diff * pred_std
}
```

```{r}
#XGBoost for Total
## =========================
## XGBoost for TOTAL SCORE (ScoreTotal_target)
## Train on ONE row per game (home only),
## then map predictions back to full train/test/val/data
## =========================

library(dplyr)
library(xgboost)

## -------------------------
## 0) Helpers
## -------------------------
RMSE <- function(a, b) sqrt(mean((a - b)^2))

clean_nonfinite <- function(df) {
  for (cn in names(df)) if (is.numeric(df[[cn]])) {
    bad <- !is.finite(df[[cn]])
    if (any(bad)) df[[cn]][bad] <- NA_real_
  }
  df
}

align_to_train <- function(X, train_cols) {
  miss <- setdiff(train_cols, colnames(X))
  if (length(miss)) {
    X <- cbind(
      X,
      matrix(
        0,
        nrow = nrow(X),
        ncol = length(miss),
        dimnames = list(NULL, miss)
      )
    )
  }
  X[, train_cols, drop = FALSE]
}

# Build X / y from a single model.frame so rows stay aligned
build_xy <- function(df, y_name, for_training, col_ref = NULL) {
  df  <- clean_nonfinite(df)
  fml <- as.formula(sprintf("%s ~ .", y_name))

  mf <- model.frame(
    fml,
    data = df,
    na.action = na.pass,
    drop.unused.levels = FALSE
  )

  y <- model.response(mf)
  if (for_training) {
    keep <- !is.na(y)
    mf   <- mf[keep, , drop = FALSE]
    y    <- y[keep]
  } else {
    if (anyNA(y)) y <- NULL
  }

  X <- model.matrix(delete.response(terms(mf)), data = mf)
  if ("(Intercept)" %in% colnames(X)) {
    X <- X[, setdiff(colnames(X), "(Intercept)"), drop = FALSE]
  }

  if (!is.null(col_ref)) {
    X <- align_to_train(X, train_cols = col_ref)
  }

  list(X = X, y = y)
}

## -------------------------
## 1) Build modeling frames
##    (include IDs + target explicitly)
## -------------------------
# Assumes:
#   - game_id exists
#   - posteam_type is "home"/"away"
#   - ScoreTotal_target exists (home_score + away_score)

train2 <- train_home %>%
  dplyr::select(game_id, posteam_type, 19:23, 905, 908:910, 914:1084, ScoreTotal_target)

test2  <- test %>%
  dplyr::select(game_id, posteam_type, 19:23, 905, 908:910, 914:1084, ScoreTotal_target)

val2   <- val %>%
  dplyr::select(game_id, posteam_type, 19:23, 905, 908:910, 914:1084, ScoreTotal_target)

data2  <- data %>%
  dplyr::select(game_id, posteam_type, 19:23, 905, 908:910, 914:1084, ScoreTotal_target)


# home/away indices in the FULL frames (for mapping later)
train_home_idx <- train$posteam_type == "home"
test_home_idx  <- test$posteam_type  == "home"
val_home_idx   <- val$posteam_type   == "home"

## -------------------------
## 2) Training frame: HOME rows only
## -------------------------
# Keep only home rows for training
train_df <- train2 %>%
  filter(posteam_type == "home")

# We'll use these to map predictions back to away rows by game_id if needed
train_home_gid <- train_df$game_id

# For modeling, drop identifiers and posteam_type
train_df <- train_df %>%
  dplyr::select(-game_id, -posteam_type)

# Test / val / data frames keep ALL rows for prediction
test_df <- test2 %>%
  dplyr::select(-game_id, -posteam_type)

val_df  <- val2 %>%
  dplyr::select(-game_id, -posteam_type)

data_df <- data2 %>%
  dplyr::select(-game_id, -posteam_type)

## -------------------------
## 3) Align factor levels across datasets
## -------------------------
fac_cols_total <- names(Filter(is.factor, train_df))

for (cn in fac_cols_total) {
  lv <- levels(train_df[[cn]])
  if (cn %in% names(test_df)) test_df[[cn]] <- factor(test_df[[cn]], levels = lv)
  if (cn %in% names(val_df))  val_df[[cn]]  <- factor(val_df[[cn]],  levels = lv)
  if (cn %in% names(data_df)) data_df[[cn]] <- factor(data_df[[cn]], levels = lv)
}
fac_levels_total <- lapply(train_df[fac_cols_total], levels)

## -------------------------
## 4) Build matrices (TOTAL target)
## -------------------------
y_name_total <- "ScoreTotal_target"

# TRAIN defines the feature universe (HOME rows only)
bt  <- build_xy(train_df, y_name_total, for_training = TRUE)
X_train_total <- bt$X
y_train_total <- as.numeric(bt$y)
train_cols_total <- colnames(X_train_total)

# TEST / VAL aligned to TRAIN cols (all rows, no dropping by target)
bte <- build_xy(test_df, y_name_total, for_training = FALSE,
                col_ref = train_cols_total)
X_test_total <- bte$X
y_test_total <- as.numeric(test_df[[y_name_total]])

bv  <- build_xy(val_df, y_name_total, for_training = FALSE,
                col_ref = train_cols_total)
X_val_total <- bv$X
y_val_total <- as.numeric(val_df[[y_name_total]])

# DATA: can have NA labels; treat as unlabeled for prediction
bd <- build_xy(data_df, y_name_total, for_training = FALSE,
               col_ref = train_cols_total)
X_data_total <- bd$X
y_data_total <- if (!is.null(bd$y)) as.numeric(bd$y) else NULL

## -------------------------
## 5) Guards + DMatrix
## -------------------------
stopifnot(
  nrow(X_train_total) == length(y_train_total),
  nrow(X_test_total)  == length(y_test_total),
  nrow(X_val_total)   == length(y_val_total)
)

if (!is.null(y_data_total) && nrow(X_data_total) != length(y_data_total)) {
  message(
    sprintf(
      "DATA guard: rows(X_data_total)=%s, len(y_data_total)=%s -> treating as unlabeled.",
      nrow(X_data_total), length(y_data_total)
    )
  )
  y_data_total <- NULL
}

dtrain_total <- xgb.DMatrix(X_train_total, label = y_train_total, missing = NA)
dtest_total  <- xgb.DMatrix(X_test_total,  missing = NA)
dval_total   <- xgb.DMatrix(X_val_total,   missing = NA)

ddata_total <- if (is.null(y_data_total)) {
  xgb.DMatrix(X_data_total, missing = NA)
} else {
  xgb.DMatrix(X_data_total, label = y_data_total, missing = NA)
}

## Optional: quick NA diagnostics
na_top <- sort(colSums(is.na(X_train_total)), decreasing = TRUE)
print(head(na_top, 10))


## -------------------------
## 6) Hyperparameter tuning via xgb.cv (with early stopping)
## -------------------------
set.seed(215)
## =========================
## Reuse tuned TOTAL hyperparameters (no CV)
## =========================

# Load previously tuned params + nrounds
tuned_total <- readRDS("../output/xgb_Billytotal_best_params.rds")

best_total_params  <- tuned_total$params
best_total_nrounds <- tuned_total$nrounds

cat("\nReusing TOTAL hyperparameters:\n")
str(best_total_params)
cat("nrounds:", best_total_nrounds, "\n")

## Train final TOTAL model with reused hyperparams
xgb_total_model <- xgb.train(
  params    = best_total_params,
  data      = dtrain_total,
  nrounds   = best_total_nrounds,
  watchlist = list(train = dtrain_total),
  verbose   = 0
)




## -------------------------
## 8) Predictions back into train/test/val/data
## -------------------------
# Initialize columns
train$TotalScore_xgb <- NA_real_
test$TotalScore_xgb  <- NA_real_
val$TotalScore_xgb   <- NA_real_
data$TotalScore_xgb  <- NA_real_

# TRAIN: model was fit on HOME rows only
train$TotalScore_xgb[train_home_idx] <- predict(xgb_total_model, dtrain_total)

# TEST / VAL / DATA: all rows
test$TotalScore_xgb  <- predict(xgb_total_model, dtest_total)
val$TotalScore_xgb   <- predict(xgb_total_model, dval_total)
data$TotalScore_xgb  <- predict(xgb_total_model, ddata_total)

# OPTIONAL: copy each game's home prediction to its away row
copy_home_to_away <- function(df) {
  if (!all(c("game_id", "posteam_type", "TotalScore_xgb") %in% names(df))) return(df)
  home_rows <- df$posteam_type == "home"
  away_rows <- df$posteam_type == "away"
  home_gid  <- df$game_id[home_rows]
  home_pred <- df$TotalScore_xgb[home_rows]
  df$TotalScore_xgb[away_rows] <- home_pred[ match(df$game_id[away_rows], home_gid) ]
  df
}

train <- copy_home_to_away(train)
test  <- copy_home_to_away(test)
val   <- copy_home_to_away(val)
data  <- copy_home_to_away(data)

## -------------------------

h_train <- train$posteam_type == "home"

## -------------------------

if (all(c("total_line","ScoreTotal_target_cover") %in% names(train))) {
  train$Cover_TotalScore_xgb <- ifelse(train$TotalScore_xgb >= train$total_line, 1, 0)
```

```{r}
## ---- xgb-team-score ------------------------------------------------------
library(dplyr)
library(xgboost)

safe_predict_xgb <- function(df_raw, model, y_name, train_cols, fac_levels) {
  stopifnot(inherits(model, "xgb.Booster"))
  df <- df_raw

  # align factor levels to training
  for (nm in names(fac_levels)) if (nm %in% names(df)) {
    df[[nm]] <- factor(df[[nm]], levels = fac_levels[[nm]])
  }

  # clean non-finite numerics
  for (cn in names(df)) if (is.numeric(df[[cn]])) {
    bad <- !is.finite(df[[cn]])
    if (any(bad)) df[[cn]][bad] <- NA_real_
  }

  # model.frame -> model.matrix (keep rownames for re-embed)
  fml <- as.formula(sprintf("%s ~ .", y_name))
  mf  <- model.frame(fml, data = df, na.action = na.pass, drop.unused.levels = FALSE)
  X   <- model.matrix(delete.response(terms(mf)), data = mf)
  if ("(Intercept)" %in% colnames(X)) {
    X <- X[, setdiff(colnames(X), "(Intercept)"), drop = FALSE]
  }

  # align columns to training design
  miss <- setdiff(train_cols, colnames(X))
  if (length(miss)) {
    X <- cbind(X, matrix(0, nrow = nrow(X), ncol = length(miss),
                         dimnames = list(NULL, miss)))
  }
  X <- X[, train_cols, drop = FALSE]

  # ✅ correct dispatch target: xgb.Booster
  p <- as.numeric(predict(model, newdata = xgb.DMatrix(X, missing = NA)))

  # re-embed to original row count
  out <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(df_raw))
  idx <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(rownames(X)))
  out[idx] <- p
  out
}


# Slice columns: predictors 24:195, 378:549, 732:903 + 914, 972, and target at 960
train2 <- dplyr::select(train, 19:23, 905, 908:910, 914:1084, Score_target)
test2  <- dplyr::select(test,  19:23, 905, 908:910, 914:1084, Score_target)
val2   <- dplyr::select(val,   19:23, 905, 908:910, 914:1084, Score_target)
data2  <- dplyr::select(data,  19:23, 905, 908:910, 914:1084, Score_target)

# ---------- Helpers (self-contained) ----------
RMSE <- function(a, b) sqrt(mean((a - b)^2))

clean_nonfinite <- function(df) {
  for (cn in names(df)) if (is.numeric(df[[cn]])) {
    bad <- !is.finite(df[[cn]])
    if (any(bad)) df[[cn]][bad] <- NA_real_
  }
  df
}

align_to_train <- function(X, train_cols) {
  miss <- setdiff(train_cols, colnames(X))
  if (length(miss)) {
    X <- cbind(X, matrix(0, nrow = nrow(X), ncol = length(miss),
                         dimnames = list(NULL, miss)))
  }
  X[, train_cols, drop = FALSE]
}

build_xy <- function(df, y_name, for_training, col_ref = NULL) {
  df  <- clean_nonfinite(df)
  fml <- as.formula(sprintf("%s ~ .", y_name))
  mf  <- model.frame(fml, data = df, na.action = na.pass, drop.unused.levels = FALSE)
  y   <- model.response(mf)
  if (for_training) {
    keep <- !is.na(y); mf <- mf[keep, , drop = FALSE]; y <- y[keep]
  } else {
    if (anyNA(y)) y <- NULL
  }
  X <- model.matrix(delete.response(terms(mf)), data = mf)
  if ("(Intercept)" %in% colnames(X)) X <- X[, setdiff(colnames(X), "(Intercept)"), drop = FALSE]
  if (!is.null(col_ref)) X <- align_to_train(X, col_ref)
  list(X = X, y = y)
}


eval_print <- function(y, p, label) {
  ok <- !is.na(y) & !is.na(p)
  cat("\n", toupper(label), ":\n", sep = "")
  cat("  RMSE:        ", RMSE(y[ok], p[ok]), "\n")
  cat("  Correlation: ", if (sum(ok) > 1) cor(y[ok], p[ok]) else NA_real_, "\n")
  if (exists("LLfunction")) cat("  LogLik:      ", LLfunction(y[ok], p[ok]), "\n")
}

# ---------- Factor level alignment ----------
train_df <- train2; test_df <- test2; val_df <- val2; data_df <- data2
fac_cols <- names(Filter(is.factor, train_df))
for (cn in fac_cols) {
  lv <- levels(train_df[[cn]])
  test_df[[cn]] <- factor(test_df[[cn]], levels = lv)
  val_df[[cn]]  <- factor(val_df[[cn]],  levels = lv)
  data_df[[cn]] <- factor(data_df[[cn]], levels = lv)
}
fac_levels_score <- lapply(train_df[fac_cols], levels)

# ---------- Build TRAIN/TEST/VAL/DATA matrices ----------
y_name_score <- "Score_target"

# TRAIN: drop NA targets
bt  <- build_xy(train_df, y_name_score, for_training = TRUE)
Xtr <- bt$X; ytr <- as.numeric(bt$y); train_cols_score <- colnames(Xtr)

# TEST: keep all rows, y from original df
bte <- build_xy(test_df, y_name_score, for_training = FALSE, col_ref = train_cols_score)
Xte <- bte$X
yte <- as.numeric(test_df[[y_name_score]])

# VAL: keep all rows, y from original df
bv  <- build_xy(val_df,  y_name_score, for_training = FALSE, col_ref = train_cols_score)
Xva <- bv$X
yva <- as.numeric(val_df[[y_name_score]])

# DATA: prediction-only
bd  <- build_xy(data_df, y_name_score, for_training = FALSE, col_ref = train_cols_score)
Xda <- bd$X  # y is unused for prediction

dtr <- xgb.DMatrix(Xtr, label = ytr, missing = NA)

## =========================
## Reuse tuned SCORE hyperparameters (no CV)
## =========================

# Build Xtr / dtr first as you already do, then:

tuned_score <- readRDS("../output/xgb_Billyscore_best_params.rds")

best_score_params  <- tuned_score$params
best_score_nrounds <- tuned_score$nrounds

cat("\nReusing SCORE hyperparameters:\n")
str(best_score_params)
cat("nrounds:", best_score_nrounds, "\n")

xgb_score_model <- xgb.train(
  params  = best_score_params,
  data    = dtr,
  nrounds = best_score_nrounds,
  verbose = 0
)



# ---------- Safe predictions back to full data frames ----------
train$Score_xgb <- safe_predict_xgb(train2, xgb_score_model, y_name_score, train_cols_score, fac_levels_score)
test$Score_xgb  <- safe_predict_xgb(test2,  xgb_score_model, y_name_score, train_cols_score, fac_levels_score)
val$Score_xgb   <- safe_predict_xgb(val2,   xgb_score_model, y_name_score, train_cols_score, fac_levels_score)
data$Score_xgb  <- safe_predict_xgb(data2,  xgb_score_model, y_name_score, train_cols_score, fac_levels_score)

# ---------- Evaluation ----------
eval_print(train2[[y_name_score]], train$Score_xgb, "train")
eval_print(test2[[y_name_score]],  test$Score_xgb,  "test")
eval_print(val2[[y_name_score]],   val$Score_xgb,   "validation")

# Optional cover-vs-line
if (all(c("posteam_implied","Score_target_cover") %in% names(train))) {
  tr_ok <- !is.na(train$Score_xgb) & !is.na(train$posteam_implied)
  acc <- 1 - mean(ifelse(train$Score_xgb[tr_ok] > train$posteam_implied[tr_ok], 1, 0) != train$Score_target_cover[tr_ok])
  cat("TRAIN Cover Accuracy (Team Score): ", acc, "\n", sep = "")
}
if (all(c("posteam_implied","Score_target_cover") %in% names(test))) {
  te_ok <- !is.na(test$Score_xgb) & !is.na(test$posteam_implied)
  acc <- 1 - mean(ifelse(test$Score_xgb[te_ok] > test$posteam_implied[te_ok], 1, 0) != test$Score_target_cover[te_ok])
  cat("TEST  Cover Accuracy (Team Score): ", acc, "\n", sep = "")
}
if (all(c("posteam_implied","Score_target_cover") %in% names(val))) {
  va_ok <- !is.na(val$Score_xgb) & !is.na(val$posteam_implied)
  acc <- 1 - mean(ifelse(val$Score_xgb[va_ok] > val$posteam_implied[va_ok], 1, 0) != val$Score_target_cover[va_ok])
  cat("VAL   Cover Accuracy (Team Score): ", acc, "\n", sep = "")
}

# Peek importance
print(head(xgb.importance(model = xgb_score_model), 20))
```

```{r}
# ---------- HOME model ----------

score_home_test2  <- dplyr::select(test_home,  19:23, 905, 908:910, 914:1084, Score_target)

score_home_val_df   <- score_home_val2

# Align factor levels (if any) within HOME subset
score_home_fac_cols <- names(Filter(is.factor, score_home_train_df))
for (cn in score_home_fac_cols) {
  lv <- levels(score_home_train_df[[cn]])
  if (cn %in% names(score_home_test_df)) score_home_test_df[[cn]] <- factor(score_home_test_df[[cn]], levels = lv)
  if (cn %in% names(score_home_val_df))  score_home_val_df[[cn]]  <- factor(score_home_val_df[[cn]],  levels = lv)
}
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

add_opp_score_xgb <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    group_by(game_id) %>%
    mutate(
      .side = tolower(as.character(posteam_type)),
      OppScore_HA_xgb = case_when(
        .side == "home" ~ Score_HA_xgb[.side == "away"][1],
        .side == "away" ~ Score_HA_xgb[.side == "home"][1],
        TRUE            ~ NA_real_
      )
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::select(-.side)
}

```

################################################################################################




```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(rlang)

add_opp_score_xgb <- function(df,
                              game_col = "game_id",
                              type_col = "posteam_type",
                              score_col = "Score_xgb",
                              out_col   = "OppScore_xgb") {

  game_sym  <- rlang::sym(game_col)
  type_sym  <- rlang::sym(type_col)
  score_sym <- rlang::sym(score_col)

  # Normalize side labels to "home"/"away"
  df_norm <- df %>%
    mutate(
      .side = tolower(as.character(!!type_sym)),
      .side = dplyr::recode(
        .side,
        "h" = "home", "home" = "home",
        "a" = "away", "away" = "away"
      )
    )

  # Per-game wide table for the XGB score
  wide <- df_norm %>%
    transmute(!!game_sym, .side, .score = !!score_sym) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from   = .side,
      values_from  = .score,
      values_fn    = dplyr::first,
      names_prefix = ".score_"   # <-- gives .score_home, .score_away
    )

  df_norm %>%
    left_join(wide, by = rlang::as_name(game_sym)) %>%
    mutate(
      !!out_col := dplyr::if_else(.side == "home", .score_away, .score_home)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-.side, -starts_with(".score_"))
}

# Apply to each data frame
data  <- add_opp_score_xgb(data)
train <- add_opp_score_xgb(train)
test  <- add_opp_score_xgb(test)
val   <- add_opp_score_xgb(val)

```

```{r}
test$ScoreDiff_xgb_score  <- test$Score_xgb  - test$OppScore_xgb

  train$ScoreDiff_xgb_score >= train$favored_by, 1, 0
)

  train$ScoreDiff_target_cover != train$Cover_ScoreDiff_xgb_score,
```

#Summary Table of Results
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(kableExtra)

# =========================
# 0) Helpers for averaging
# =========================
row_mean_or_na <- function(df, cols) {
  if (length(cols) == 0) return(rep(NA_real_, nrow(df)))
  m <- as.matrix(df[, cols, drop = FALSE])
  out <- rowMeans(m, na.rm = TRUE)
  out[!is.finite(out)] <- NA_real_
  out
}

get_cols <- function(nms, patterns, drop_targets = TRUE) {
  cols <- sort(unique(unlist(lapply(patterns, function(p)
    grep(p, nms, value = TRUE, perl = TRUE)
  ))))
  if (drop_targets) {
    cols <- cols[!grepl("(_target$|_target_cover$)", cols, perl = TRUE)]
  }
  cols
}

# =========================
# A) Prep: ensure ImpliedTeamScored_* exists for common suffixes
# =========================
suffixes <- c("forward","stepwise","enet","randforest","xgb","all","avg","avgreg")

for (dfname in c("train","test","val","data")) {
  df <- get(dfname)

  for (suf in suffixes) {
    score_col   <- paste0("Score_", suf)
    implied_col <- paste0("ImpliedTeamScored_", suf)
    if (!(implied_col %in% names(df)) && (score_col %in% names(df))) {
      df[[implied_col]] <- df[[score_col]]
    }
  }

  assign(dfname, df, inherits = TRUE)
}

# =========================
# B) Add averaged ensemble predictions to each split
#     (uses *_avg_final so we don't overwrite existing *_avg)
# =========================
add_avg_preds <- function(df) {
  nms <- names(df)

  # Score (team) — include Score_* (excluding ScoreDiff_) and ImpliedTeamScored_*
  score_cols <- get_cols(
    nms,
    patterns = c("^Score_(?!Diff_).+", "^ImpliedTeamScored_.+"),
    drop_targets = TRUE
  )

  # Opponent Score
  opp_cols <- get_cols(
    nms,
    patterns = c("^OppScore_.+", "^ImpliedOppScored_.+"),
    drop_targets = TRUE
  )

  # Total — include all your total-style prefixes
  total_cols <- get_cols(
    nms,
    patterns = c("^(ScoreTotal_|Total_|TotalScore_|ImpliedTotal_|ImpliedScoreTotal_).+"),
    drop_targets = TRUE
  )

  # Score Difference
  diff_cols <- get_cols(
    nms,
    patterns = c("^ScoreDiff_.+", "^ImpliedScoreDiff_.+"),
    drop_targets = TRUE
  )

  # NEW final ensemble variables
  df$Score_avg_final      <- row_mean_or_na(df, score_cols)
  df$OppScore_avg_final   <- row_mean_or_na(df, opp_cols)
  df$ScoreTotal_avg_final <- row_mean_or_na(df, total_cols)
  df$ScoreDiff_avg_final  <- row_mean_or_na(df, diff_cols)

  df
}

train <- add_avg_preds(train)
test  <- add_avg_preds(test)
val   <- add_avg_preds(val)
data  <- add_avg_preds(data)

# =========================
# C) Map each predictor name to its targets / thresholds
# =========================
resolve_targets <- function(colname) {
  base <- colname

  if (grepl("^Team_ImpliedTotal_", base) || grepl("^ImpliedTeamScored_", base)) {
    list(numeric_target = "Score_target",
         cover_target   = "Score_target_cover",
         threshold_col  = "posteam_implied")

  } else if (grepl("^ImpliedOppScored_", base)) {
    list(numeric_target = "OppScore_target",
         cover_target   = "OppScore_target_cover",
         threshold_col  = "defteam_implied")

  } else if (grepl("^(ScoreTotal_|Total_|TotalScore_|ImpliedTotal_|ImpliedScoreTotal_)", base)) {
    list(numeric_target = "ScoreTotal_target",
         cover_target   = "ScoreTotal_target_cover",
         threshold_col  = "total_line")

  } else if (grepl("^OppScore_", base)) {
    list(numeric_target = "OppScore_target",
         cover_target   = "OppScore_target_cover",
         threshold_col  = "defteam_implied")

  } else if (grepl("^(ScoreDiff_|ImpliedScoreDiff_)", base)) {
    list(numeric_target = "ScoreDiff_target",
         cover_target   = "ScoreDiff_target_cover",
         threshold_col  = "favored_by")

  } else if (grepl("^Score_", base)) {
    list(numeric_target = "Score_target",
         cover_target   = "Score_target_cover",
         threshold_col  = "posteam_implied")

  } else {
    list(numeric_target = NA_character_,
         cover_target   = NA_character_,
         threshold_col  = NA_character_)
  }
}

# =========================
# D) Collect variables to evaluate (EXCLUDES Cover_*)
# =========================
all_names <- unique(c(names(train), names(test), names(val)))

pred_pattern <- paste0(
  "^(",
    "(ScoreTotal|Total|TotalScore|ImpliedTotal|ImpliedScoreTotal)",  # totals (new prefixes included)
    "|Score|OppScore|ScoreDiff|ImpliedScoreDiff|ImpliedTeamScored|ImpliedOppScored|Team_ImpliedTotal",
  ")_.+"
)

vars_to_check <- sort(all_names[grepl(pred_pattern, all_names)])
vars_to_check <- vars_to_check[!grepl("(_target$|_target_cover$)", vars_to_check, perl = TRUE)]
vars_to_check <- vars_to_check[!startsWith(vars_to_check, "Cover_")]  # safety

# =========================
# E) Evaluator (numeric RMSE/MSE/Corr + % Correct from thresholded numeric preds)
# =========================
eval_split <- function(df, split_label, variables) {
  out <- lapply(variables, function(v) {
    m <- resolve_targets(v)
    nt <- m$numeric_target
    ct <- m$cover_target
    th <- m$threshold_col

    row <- tibble(
      Split          = split_label,
      Variable       = v,
      Numeric_Target = nt,
      RMSE           = NA_real_,
      MSE            = NA_real_,
      Correlation    = NA_real_,
      Pct_Correct    = NA_real_
    )

    # Numeric metrics vs numeric target (if present)
    if (all(c(v, nt) %in% names(df))) {
      yhat <- df[[v]]
      y    <- df[[nt]]
      ok   <- is.finite(yhat) & is.finite(y)
      if (any(ok)) {
        row$RMSE        <- sqrt(mean((yhat[ok] - y[ok])^2))
        row$MSE         <- mean((yhat[ok] - y[ok])^2)
        row$Correlation <- suppressWarnings(cor(y[ok], yhat[ok]))
      }
    }

    # If a threshold + cover target exist, compute cover success from numeric predictor
    if (all(c(v, th, ct) %in% names(df))) {
      yhat <- df[[v]]
      thr  <- df[[th]]
      ycov <- df[[ct]]
      ok   <- is.finite(yhat) & is.finite(thr) & is.finite(ycov)
      if (any(ok)) {
        pred_cover <- as.integer(yhat[ok] >= thr[ok])
        row$Pct_Correct <- mean(pred_cover == as.integer(ycov[ok]))
      }
    }

    row
  })

  dplyr::bind_rows(out)
}

# =========================
# F) Build summary_tbl
# =========================
summary_tbl <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  eval_split(train, "TRAIN", vars_to_check),
  eval_split(test,  "TEST",  vars_to_check),
  eval_split(val,   "VAL",   vars_to_check),
  eval_split(data,  "DATA",  vars_to_check)
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Split = factor(Split, levels = c("TRAIN","TEST","VAL","DATA"))) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Split, Variable)

# =========================
# G) Display table (no Cover_*; shows Correlation)
# =========================
small_tbl <- summary_tbl %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Variable    = gsub("_", "_\u200b", Variable),
    RMSE        = round(RMSE, 2),
    MSE         = round(MSE, 2),
    Correlation = round(Correlation, 3),
    `% Correct` = ifelse(is.na(Pct_Correct), "", paste0(round(100 * Pct_Correct, 1), "%"))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    Split, Variable, `Num Target` = Numeric_Target,
    RMSE, MSE, Correlation, `% Correct`
  )

kable(small_tbl, format = "html", escape = FALSE) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE,
                bootstrap_options = c("striped","condensed","hover"),
                font_size = 12) %>%
  column_spec(1, width = "6em")  %>%
  column_spec(2, width = "20em") %>%
  column_spec(3, width = "12em")

```


# Average Summary Table
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(kableExtra)

cat_avgs <- summary_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    Category = case_when(
      grepl("^(ScoreTotal_|Total_|TotalScore_|ImpliedTotal_|ImpliedScoreTotal_)", Variable) ~ "Total",
      grepl("^OppScore_", Variable)                                                         ~ "OppScore",
      grepl("^(ScoreDiff_|ImpliedScoreDiff_)", Variable)                                    ~ "ScoreDiff",
      grepl("^Score_", Variable) & !grepl("^ScoreDiff_", Variable)                          ~ "Score",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Category)) %>%
  mutate(Split = factor(Split, levels = c("TRAIN","TEST","VAL","DATA"))) %>%
  group_by(Split, Category) %>%
  summarise(
    Avg_RMSE = mean(RMSE, na.rm = TRUE),
    Avg_MSE  = mean(MSE,  na.rm = TRUE),
    Avg_Corr = mean(Correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
    Avg_Pct  = mean(Pct_Correct, na.rm = TRUE),  # thresholded numeric preds only
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(Split, Category)

cat_avgs_disp <- cat_avgs %>%
  transmute(
    Split, Category,
    RMSE = round(Avg_RMSE, 2),
    MSE  = round(Avg_MSE, 2),
    Corr = round(Avg_Corr, 3),
    `% Correct` = ifelse(is.na(Avg_Pct), "", paste0(round(100 * Avg_Pct, 1), "%"))
  )

kable(cat_avgs_disp, format = "html", escape = FALSE) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE,
                bootstrap_options = c("striped","condensed","hover"),
                font_size = 14) %>%
  column_spec(1, width = "6em") %>%
  column_spec(2, width = "10em")

```
